```{python}
#| label: fig-ggnmos
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "The grounded-gate NMOS (ggNMOS) ESD protection device: (a) cross section with the parasitic lateral NPN (drain = collector, substrate = base, source = emitter) and the substrate resistance $R_\\mathrm{sub}$; the drain contact is set back from the gate with blocked silicide, forming a ballast resistance; (b) snapback I/V characteristic—after avalanche breakdown at $V_\\mathrm{t1}$, the parasitic NPN turns on and the device conducts the ESD current at a low holding voltage $V_\\mathrm{h}$."

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle, FancyArrowPatch

fig, axs = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(8, 3.6),
                        gridspec_kw={'width_ratios': [1.4, 1]})

C = dict(sub='#f5e9d0', ox='#c7dff2', poly='#3e9c5c', nplus='#4a7fb5',
         metal='#8f8f8f')

# (a) cross section
ax = axs[0]
SURF = 3.0
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((0, 0), 15, SURF, fc=C['sub'], ec='k', lw=0.8))
ax.text(2.0, 0.5, 'p-substrate', fontsize=8)
# source n+
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((1.5, SURF - 0.5), 2.0, 0.5, fc=C['nplus'],
                       ec='k', lw=0.6))
ax.text(2.5, SURF - 0.25, '$n^+$ S', ha='center', va='center',
        fontsize=7, color='white')
# drain n+ (extended)
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((4.7, SURF - 0.5), 6.9, 0.5, fc=C['nplus'],
                       ec='k', lw=0.6))
ax.text(8.15, SURF - 0.25, '$n^+$ D (extended, silicide blocked)',
        ha='center', va='center', fontsize=7, color='white')
# gate
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((3.5, SURF), 1.2, 0.12, fc=C['ox'], ec='k', lw=0.4))
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((3.5, SURF + 0.12), 1.2, 0.4, fc=C['poly'],
                       ec='k', lw=0.5))
# terminals
ax.plot([2.5, 2.5], [SURF, SURF + 1.3], 'k-', lw=1.0)
ax.text(2.5, SURF + 1.5, 'S + G + B\n($V_\\mathrm{SS}$)', ha='center',
        fontsize=8)
ax.plot([4.1, 2.5], [SURF + 0.52, SURF + 1.3], 'k-', lw=1.0)
ax.plot([8.15, 8.15], [SURF, SURF + 1.3], 'k-', lw=1.0)
ax.text(8.15, SURF + 1.5, 'D (pad)', ha='center', fontsize=8)
# substrate contact
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((12.6, SURF - 0.5), 1.2, 0.5, fc='#d1862c',
                       ec='k', lw=0.6))
ax.text(13.2, SURF - 0.25, '$p^+$', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=7,
        color='white')
ax.plot([13.2, 13.2], [SURF, SURF + 1.3], 'k-', lw=1.0)
ax.text(13.2, SURF + 1.5, 'B ($V_\\mathrm{SS}$)', ha='center', fontsize=8)
# parasitic NPN sketch
ax.annotate('NPN', xy=(4.0, 1.6), fontsize=9, color='#b02020',
            ha='center')
ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch((5.2, 2.3), (3.2, 2.3), arrowstyle='->',
                             mutation_scale=10, lw=1.2, color='#b02020'))
ax.text(10.3, 1.2, '$R_\\mathrm{sub}$', fontsize=9, color='#b02020')
ax.plot([8.15, 12.6], [1.9, 1.9], color='#b02020', lw=1.2, ls=':')
ax.set_xlim(-0.2, 15.2)
ax.set_ylim(-0.3, 5.4)
ax.set_aspect('equal')
ax.axis('off')
ax.set_title('(a)', fontsize=10)

# (b) snapback IV
ax = axs[1]
# branch 1: off-state leakage up to Vt1
v1 = np.linspace(0, 8, 50)
i1 = 0.15 * (v1 / 8)**14
ax.plot(v1, i1, 'b-', lw=2)
# snapback jump
ax.annotate('', xy=(4.5, 0.35), xytext=(8, 0.15),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', lw=1.2, ls='--',
                            color='gray'))
# branch 2: on-state
i2 = np.linspace(0.35, 2.6, 50)
v2 = 4.5 + (i2 - 0.35) * 1.1
ax.plot(v2, i2, 'b-', lw=2)
ax.plot([8], [0.15], 'bo', ms=4)
ax.plot([4.5], [0.35], 'bo', ms=4)
ax.text(7.6, 0.45, '$V_\\mathrm{t1}$ (trigger)', fontsize=8, ha='center')
ax.text(3.6, 0.6, '$V_\\mathrm{h}$', fontsize=8)
ax.text(2.4, 2.0, 'snapback\nregion', fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel('$V_\\mathrm{DS}$ (V)')
ax.set_ylabel('$I_\\mathrm{D}$ (A)')
ax.set_xlim(0, 9)
ax.set_ylim(0, 2.8)
ax.grid(alpha=0.3)
ax.set_title('(b)', fontsize=10)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
